witness_judgments.summary: The non-null premise eliminates the null arm of store_circular_area_or_null; unfolding store_circular_area supplies exactly the existential representation witnesses, logical-state fact, and descriptor/backing resources required by the internal assertion.
readidx <> writeidx contradicts the full-state direction of CircularAreaLogicalState, hence the logical contents length differs from capacity and CircularAreaStateFullResult state 0 holds.
Equal indices with b_status = 0 imply logical length 0; positive capacity then rules out fullness and establishes CircularAreaStateFullResult state 0.
CircularAreaLogicalState restricts b_status to 0 or 1, so b_status <> 0 gives b_status = 1; equal indices and status 1 then imply logical length equals capacity and result 1.
With circular_area_pre = 0, unfolding store_circular_area_or_null selects its null emp arm; ERROR is the literal 1 and GlobalStrings is preserved.
The literal-address side condition is the arithmetic identity base + 0 * sizeof(CHAR) = base and is independent of the framed resources.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Select the first generated alternative for each disjunctive witness. Unfold store_circular_area_or_null/store_circular_area at ownership boundaries, use CircularAreaLogicalState directly to derive the three result facts, refold unchanged live ownership, and normalize the null and string-literal equalities.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Non-equal indices mean not full; equal indices with status 0 mean empty and therefore not full because capacity is positive; equal indices with nonzero status force status 1 and fullness. The concrete descriptor and mixed buffer never change, so they reconstitute the original public resource.
